text:
Ellen (PM): Quick sync: assemble 'tenant guardrails' for private deploy launch. Need crisp lines for packaging, upgrade lanes, and customer-network responsibilities that sales can paste.
Ravi (Eng): Propose 3 guardrails: Lite (self-serve), Managed (field-assisted), Contracted (SOW-bound). Call out pinned-version costs and KV migration risk.
Sam (Infra): Operational must-haves: for preserved egress IPs we require a signed IP reservation + named network owner. Pinned versions increase storage and extend recovery windows.
Maya (Sales): Field asks: monthly blocked maintenance window sells well. Customers want predictable blackout slots around month-end. Offer: monthly slot add-on or per-event voucher.
Priya (Legal): Contract phrasing: 'Blackout windows and reserved egress IPs are contractual only for Contracted tier when listed in the SOW; other tiers receive best-effort accommodation.' Pasteable.
Ravi (Eng): Small YAML snippet for docs: ```yaml
preset: managed
telemetry: opt_out
upgrade_policy: scheduled_with_customer
egress_reservation: reserved_on_request
blackout: monthly_slot
```
Sam (Infra): Ops footnote to include: 'Pinned versions may add ~30-90m rollback delta and +10-25% storage overhead depending on KV size.' We'll refine numbers later.
Ellen (PM): Launch checklist: 1) Pasteable one-liners per preset 2) YAML presets in docs 3) SOW snippet 4) Ops footnotes + runbook 5) Pricing bands for blackout/egress add-ons.
ops-bot: Created ticket PRIV-4200 for 'Tenant guardrails + launch blurb', assigned to Ellen.
Ellen (PM): Actions: Ravi -> full presets + perf targets (Tue). Sam -> runbook + measured ops deltas (Mon). Priya -> SOW blurb (Wed). Maya -> sample pricing and two paste-lines per preset (Thu).
